2121972468210401485.en_summary: $NVDA Do or die week for Nvidia. The stock has moved from elevated levels into deeply oversold territory and is now testing major support. A short-term bounce is plausible, but the broader structure remains under pressure until key levels are reclaimed. All key EMAs remain above price and are beginning to roll over, confirming the recent loss of momentum. MACD is deeply negative and volume expanded on the decline, consistent with aggressive selling pressure.
2121972468210401485.zh_summary: $NVDA 對 Nvidia 是生死週。股價已從高位進入深度超賣區域，現正測試主要支撑。短期反彈是合理的，但更廣泛結構仍受壓力，直到關鍵水平被收回。所有關鍵 EMA 仍在價格上方並開始轉向下，確認近期動能喪失。MACD 深度負值，下跌時成交量擴大，與激進賣壓一致。

2121971558059057489.en_summary: The Week Ahead In Technology for November 16, 2026. $NVDA reports without Jensen Huang, and the numbers aren't my worry. It's a stock shock, not a business shock. Will there even be a guide? Monday on @CNBC Squawk on the Street: NVIDIA and the Anthropic IPO. $NVDA supplier commitments more than doubled to $279B, driven mostly by memory. Jensen's calls. Who makes the next one? @AnthropicAI IPO expected to price near $1T. Only circular if nobody pays. Somebody is. @Microsoft Ignite: more insights on customers paying for agents by usage not seats? Everpure $P bought components to secure supply; FCF went negative. Does it come back? @Lenovo record 9.1% infrastructure margin. Does it hold as AI servers ship? Ian Buck top internal pick for NVIDIA CEO gives SC26 address.
2121971558059057489.zh_summary: 2026 年 11 月 16 日科技週前瞻。$NVDA 在沒有 Jensen Huang 的情況下報告，數字不是我的擔憂。這是股票衝擊，不是業務衝擊。甚至會有指引嗎？週一在 @CNBC Squawk on the Street：NVIDIA 及 Anthropic IPO。$NVDA 供應商承諾超過翻倍至 2790 億美元，主要由記憶體驅動。Jensen 的電話。誰做下一個？@AnthropicAI IPO 預期定價近 1 萬億美元。只有無人支付才是循環。有人在支付。@Microsoft Ignite：更多關於客戶按使用而非座位支付代理的見解？Everpure $P 購買組件以確保供應；自由現金流轉負。會回來嗎？@Lenovo 創紀錄 9.1% 基建利潤率。隨著 AI 伺服器出貨會保持嗎？Ian Buck 是 NVIDIA CEO 內部首選，將在 SC26 發表演講。

2121970945027875193.en_summary: In just six months, $ASTS has erased all the gains from the powerful rally that began in the second half of 2025. The stock is now trading in a very important support zone that is likely to determine its next directional move. A clean break below the $30 area could open the door to further downside. On the flip side, a reclaim of $35 would be the first meaningful sign of a potential recovery.
2121970945027875193.zh_summary: 僅六個月，$ASTS 已抹去從 2025 年下半年開始的強勁反彈所有收益。股價現正交易於非常重要的支撑區，可能決定其下一個方向移動。乾淨跌破 30 美元區域可能打開進一步下行的大門。另一方面，收回 35 美元將是潛在復甦的第一個有意義蹟象。
